results.name: Actual Java-embedded blob scripts preserve a 2 MB binary recording over bounded chunks
Revoked blobs and missing page state produce errors instead of hanging or empty successful files
Cookie-bearing native downloads require the configured origin and do not follow redirects
Storage Access Framework, byte limits, cancellation cleanup and no JavaScript bridge are present

scope: Java-embedded blob JavaScript executed in a Node VM with Blob/FileReader adapters; native security boundaries inspected in source. Java compiled against Android API 23. This is not an Android device runtime test.

deviceAcceptance.reason: No attached Android device or emulator.
